text:
Priya (Docs): quick flag from the docs review. The console header shows 'Help widget' but the docs glossary calls it 'In-product docs'. Can we pick one and add explicit crosslinks?
Sam (Design): noted. 'Help widget' was a shorthand in the header to save space. I think we should keep the short header but surface the canonical term inside the panel.
Nora (PM): agree. Users expect consistent vocabulary. Proposal: keep header text 'Help' (compact), use 'In-product docs' as the canonical phrase in the first paragraph with links to glossary and usage guide.
Elliot (DevEx): feasible. Two implementation notes: 1) SPA router needs `data-internal-link` on links for hash anchors; 2) add `aria-label="In-product docs"` to the visual header so screen readers get the full name.
a11y-bot: recommendation: ensure the header aria-label exists and the intro paragraph is marked with `role=region` so screen readers can jump to it. Use `aria-live=polite` for dynamic content.
Priya (Docs): I'll add anchors: `/docs/glossary#in-product-docs` and `/docs/guides/in-product-docs#overview` and draft the short explainer: "In-product docs: contextual docs surfaced from the console. See Glossary: In-product docs and Guide: Using in-product docs."
Sam (Design): UX note for mobile: the header mustn't wrap. keep visual header to 'Help' and place the canonical phrase as the first sentence inside. On mobile collapse extra links under a 'Resources' disclosure.
Elliot (DevEx): dev note: we'll implement `data-internal-link` handling so the sidecar opens internal docs in-place (target=_self) and anchor navigation scrolls to the fragment. I'll also update i18n key `help_header` to avoid translation drift.
Nora (PM): decision summary: visual header = 'Help', first paragraph uses canonical 'In-product docs' + explicit crosslinks, aria-label on header, SPA deep link support and mobile collapse for links. Owners: Priya (docs) update anchors & copy, Sam update mocks, Elliot implement link handling and aria.
Priya (Docs): opening PR for anchor + copy now. ETA 24h.
Sam (Design): will post updated mock with mobile collapse later today.
Elliot (DevEx): scheduling the link handler change for next sprint and will add a small telemetry note if header i18n key changes.
Nora (PM): thanks everyone. we'll validate in staging once PRs land. Closing after staging signoff. :white_check_mark:
